def stat(results):
    if not results:
        return ""
    
    def parse_time(time_str):
        h, m, s = map(int, time_str.split('|'))
        return h * 3600 + m * 60 + s
    
    def format_time(seconds):
        h = seconds // 3600
        m = (seconds % 3600) // 60
        s = seconds % 60
        return f"{h:02d}|{m:02d}|{s:02d}"
    
    times = [parse_time(time) for time in results.split(', ')]
    times.sort()
    
    n = len(times)
    range_value = times[-1] - times[0]
    average_value = sum(times) // n
    median_value = times[n // 2] if n % 2 == 1 else (times[n // 2 - 1] + times[n // 2]) // 2
    
    return f"Range: {format_time(range_value)} Average: {format_time(average_value)} Median: {format_time(median_value)}"
